title: Cubature from rational approximation
summary: We present a numerical construction of cubature rules for area integrals of analytic functions over planar domains with rectifiable Jordan boundary. The starting point is the Cauchy--Green identity. Given a weight $w$, we choose a $\bar\partial$-antiderivative $W$ and reduce the area integral to a contour integral involving the boundary values of $W$. These values are then approximated by a rational function with free poles, computed by the AAA algorithm. The poles inside the domain become cubature nodes, the corresponding residues become weights, and the boundary residual controls the error…
